# 10 Oldest Sports Trophies in the World: Evolution and Comparison
## **10 Oldest Sports Trophies Still Awarded Today**
### **1. Carlisle Bells – 1599, England**
![](https://lasercrystal.co.uk/wp-content/uploads/2019/09/10-Oldest-Sports-Trophies-in-the-World-1-1.webp)

### **10. Stanley Cup – 1893, Canada**
The Stanley Cup is the oldest professional sports trophy in North America and is awarded annually to the champions of the National Hockey League.

## **Comparison Table of Historic Sports Trophies**
|  |  |  |  |  |  |
|-|-|-|-|-|-|
| Carlisle Bells | 1599 | Horse Racing | England | Silver Bells | Yes |
| Scorton Silver Arrow | 1673 | Archery | England | Silver | Yes (Replica) |
| America’s Cup | 1851 | Sailing | England | Silver | Yes |
| Claret Jug | 1873 | Golf | Scotland | Silver | Yes (Replica awarded) |
| Scottish Cup Trophy | 1874 | Football | Scotland | Silver | Yes (Replica awarded) |
| Wimbledon Trophy | 1877 | Tennis | England | Silver-gilt | Yes (Replica awarded) |
| Ashes Urn | 1882 | Cricket | Australia / England | Terracotta | Yes (Symbolic) |
| Stanley Cup | 1893 | Ice Hockey | Canada | Silver & Nickel Alloy | Yes |

Stanley Cup

The [Montreal Canadiens](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Montreal_Canadiens) have won it a record 24[[A]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Stanley_Cup#cite_note-MTL24-1) times and are the most recent Canadian-based team to win it, doing so in [1993](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/1993_Stanley_Cup_Final); the [Detroit Red Wings](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Detroit_Red_Wings) have won it 11 times, the most of any United States–based NHL team, most recently in [2008](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2008_Stanley_Cup_Final). The current holders of the Cup are the [Carolina Hurricanes](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Carolina_Hurricanes) after their victory in [2026](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2026_Stanley_Cup_Final), their second in franchise history.
